decision_tree.question: What operating system are you on?

options.label: Linux (Debian/Ubuntu/Mint)
options.description: Debian-based Linux with apt/dpkg package manager.

options.label: Linux (RHEL/Fedora/Amazon Linux)
options.description: Red Hat-based Linux with yum/dnf package manager.

options.label: macOS (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4)
options.description: macOS on Apple Silicon. Uses Homebrew cask for installation. Intel Mac users must use Docker.

options.label: Windows (with Scoop)
options.description: Windows 10/11 with Scoop package manager. If Scoop is not available, use Docker instead.

options.label: Docker Container
options.description: Fallback for Intel Mac, Windows without Scoop, or Python on macOS/Windows (the Python SDK is only supported on Linux). Platform-independent containerized setup.
